title: 'oil the mechanism' action was available and consumed a turn/HP even though I hadn't used the oil flask on it yet — the flask sat unused in inventory with no visible effect on success odds; the action seems to be a flat STR check independent of having the right item, which undercuts the point of collecting the oil flask.
